stages.label: Provision
stages.text: Describe infrastructure as code and keep every network path deliberate.

evidence.label: CloudFormation stack for queues, IAM, EC2 and CloudFront
One security group per role, VPN-only SSH

stages.label: Build & test
stages.text: Lint, test and package on every change so broken builds never reach a deploy.

evidence.label: Ruff, pytest and a Lambda package smoke build in CI
Pure detection engine with unit tests

stages.label: Secure
stages.text: No long-lived keys, least-privilege roles, and secrets masked before they travel.

evidence.label: GitHub OIDC deploy role, no stored AWS keys
Secret redaction before any model call

stages.label: Deploy
stages.text: Ship small, repeatable releases with a safe default and an explicit switch to mutate.

evidence.label: App installed through SSM Run Command, no SSH
This site: every Git push triggers a Vercel build

stages.label: Observe
stages.text: Turn logs and metrics into a few clear signals instead of a wall of noise.

stages.label: Respond
stages.text: Automate the safe responses, escalate the uncertain ones, and keep a human in the loop.

evidence.label: CI failure diagnosis with risk-labelled fixes
